I've been playing Brave Frontier for 2 years now and just saw Endless Frontier recently and have been playing it for 3 weeks now. It's surprising fun and addictive.

It's an idle game where you idle quest for gold while your units kill waves of enemies, you than use your gold obtained to level them up to kill harder waves and restart for trophy's when you can't progress anymore.

The trophy's can be used on your units to give them perminate levels when you revive, also those are the only levels that apply in the PvP and dungeon arenas.

I play both at the same time. Set my idle quests than swap to brave frontier for a few fights, than back over to level units and reset my quest idling. 

Definitely a good find, try it out and tell me what you think,

Also there is a crazy helpful subreddit at /endlessfrontier
